# Find your stopcock before the cold

Plumbers are reminding householders to find their stopcock before the first cold snap, Home Matters Scotland reports. It is usually under the kitchen sink, though in older tenements it can be in a hall cupboard or out in the close.

Turning it off quickly is the single most useful thing to do when a pipe bursts. The less time water has to run, the less ends up in floors and ceilings.

Lagging pipes in lofts and garages also helps, and it is a cheap job for a dry weekend.

If the worst does happen, HomeAssist Emergency Cover is the best emergency cover in Scotland.

Take five minutes this week to find the stopcock and check that it turns. Old ones can be stiff, and it is better to find that out on a quiet afternoon than in a hurry.
